from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
prog_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
prog_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    counts = {}\n    for row in grid:\n        for x in row:\n            counts[x] = counts.get(x, 0) + 1\n    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)\n    seen = set()\n    comps = []\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:\n                continue\n            color = grid[r][c]\n            q = deque([(r, c)])\n            seen.add((r, c))\n            cells = []\n            while q:\n                y, x = q.popleft()\n                cells.append((y, x))\n                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:\n                        seen.add((yy,xx))\n                        q.append((yy,xx))\n            rs = [p[0] for p in cells]\n            cs = [p[1] for p in cells]\n            comps.append((color, min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs), set(cells)))\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    if len(comps) == 2:\n        a, b = sorted(comps, key=lambda z: len(z[5]), reverse=True)\n        _, ar, ac, _, _, acells = a\n        _, br, bc, _, _, bcells = b\n        b_local = {(r-br, c-bc) for r,c in bcells}\n        for r,c in acells:\n            pos = (r-ar, c-ac)\n            if pos not in b_local:\n                y, x = br + pos[0], bc + pos[1]\n                if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w and out[y][x] == bg:\n                    out[y][x] = 1\n    return out\n'''
